test_item_verbatim: Otherwise the soft button will be greyed out.

tcs.tc_title: soft button greyed out when vehicle speed is above the threshold
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. CAN source: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig (HDCC27, DT27) / STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig (637, 2261, 376)
4. The shift lever is in D
5. The RVC+PAM layout is displayed in Manual Display Mode
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 206 (12.875 km/h)
2. Read the camera soft button and check that it is greyed out
tcs.expected_result:
1. BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 206 (12.875 km/h) is sent
2. The camera soft button is greyed out
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.split_reason: soft button greyed out when vehicle speed is above the threshold
tcs.test_item:
Otherwise the soft button will be greyed out.

(soft button greyed out when vehicle speed is above the threshold)

reasoning: §7.4 之第三句（`Otherwise` 即速度不低於門檻之分支）。raw 206 ＝ 12.875 km/h 為**門檻上方最近之可注入點**（8 mph ＝ 12.874752 km/h，Atl-Hi 側無恰等於之 raw，A-CA30）。與 `-029` 成一對邊界值。
